sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: In 1914 in Manhattan, the city government took ownership of an apartment building belonging to a guy named David Hess.
sentences.zh: 1914年，在曼哈顿，市政府接管了一栋属于大卫·赫斯的公寓楼。

sentences.en: They used a legal power called eminent domain, which allows governments to seize private property for public use.
sentences.zh: 他们动用了一项名为“征用权”的法律权力，允许政府为了公共用途征收私人财产。

sentences.en: In this case, they wanted to expand the subway system.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他们想要扩建地铁系统。

sentences.en: Hess fought them and lost, and when it was all said and done, his building was torn down,
sentences.zh: 赫斯反抗了，但失败了。最终，他的建筑被拆除，

sentences.en: and he was left with a triangle-shaped piece of property.
sentences.zh: 而他只剩下了一块三角形的地皮。

sentences.en: And when Roman says triangle-shaped, he means the property Hess was left with was about the size and shape of a very large slice of pizza.
sentences.zh: 当罗曼说“三角形”时，他是指赫斯剩下的那块地皮，大小和形状就像一大块披萨。

sentences.en: He was not amused.
sentences.zh: 他一点也不觉得好笑。

sentences.en: That's our producer, Katie Mingle.
sentences.zh: 那是我们的制作人，凯蒂·明格尔。

sentences.en: Later, the city tried to get him to donate his pizza-shaped property so they could build a sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 后来，市政府试图让他捐出这块披萨形状的地皮，以便他们修建人行道。

sentences.en: He refused again.
sentences.zh: 他再次拒绝了。

sentences.en: They built the sidewalk anyway, and in the middle of the sidewalk is Hess's triangle
sentences.zh: 他们还是修了人行道，而赫斯的三角形地皮就在人行道中间，

sentences.en: with a tile mosaic that reads,
sentences.zh: 上面铺着瓷砖马赛克，写着：

sentences.en: In other words, get off my f***ing triangle, jerks.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，从我这该死的三角形地皮上滚开，混蛋们。

sentences.en: It's still there, by the way, on the corner of Christopher Street and 7th Avenue in the West Village.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，它现在还在那儿，位于西村克里斯托弗街和第七大道的拐角处。

sentences.en: People like David Hess, who refuse to sell their properties, are called holdouts.
sentences.zh: 像大卫·赫斯这样拒绝出售房产的人被称为“钉子户”。

sentences.en: An eminent domain only comes into play when the government wants your property for public use.
sentences.zh: 只有当政府为了公共用途想要你的房产时，征用权才会发挥作用。

sentences.en: If it's a private development that wants your place and you refuse to sell, there's not much they can do.
sentences.zh: 如果是私人开发商想要你的地盘而你拒绝出售，他们能做的并不多。

sentences.en: Although there have been cases where eminent domain has been controversially used for private development,
sentences.zh: 尽管也曾有过征用权被争议性地用于私人开发的案例，

sentences.en: but that's another story.
sentences.zh: 但那是另一回事了。

sentences.en: In China, they call their holdout houses nail houses.
sentences.zh: 在中国，他们把这种钉子户的房子称为“钉子户”。

sentences.en: You may have seen some of the pictures of single houses sticking up like the head of a nail,
sentences.zh: 你可能见过一些照片，孤零零的房子像钉子头一样耸立着，

sentences.en: everything else around them bulldozed and carved out.
sentences.zh: 周围的一切都被推土机铲平并挖空了。

sentences.en: Basically, anywhere there's a lot of new development, there are bound to be developers
sentences.zh: 基本上，任何有大量新开发项目的地方，必然会有开发商，

sentences.en: who have plans to make lots and lots of money if they could just get that one stubborn person to move.
sentences.zh: 如果能让那个固执的人搬走，他们就能赚到大把大把的钱。

sentences.en: Which brings us to one of the most stubborn and steadfast holdouts ever, Edith Macefield.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了史上最固执、最坚定的钉子户之一：伊迪丝·梅斯菲尔德。

sentences.en: Yes, I always call her Mrs. Macefield.
sentences.zh: 是的，我总是称呼她为梅斯菲尔德太太。

sentences.en: That's Kathy Milady.
sentences.zh: 那是凯西·穆拉迪。

sentences.en: She's one of the only reporters who ever got an interview with Mrs. Macefield.
sentences.zh: 她是为数不多采访过梅斯菲尔德太太的记者之一。

sentences.en: A feat she achieved through unwavering persistence, good manners, and proper attire.
sentences.zh: 她凭借着坚定不移的毅力、良好的礼仪和得体的着装完成了这一壮举。

sentences.en: Later, I asked her, I said, what was it that made you decide to talk to me today?
sentences.zh: 后来我问她，我说，是什么让你决定今天接受我的采访？

sentences.en: And she said, I liked your skirt.
sentences.zh: 她说，我喜欢你的裙子。

sentences.en: Edith Macefield lived in a Seattle neighborhood called Ballard.
sentences.zh: 伊迪丝·梅斯菲尔德住在西雅图一个叫巴拉德的社区。

sentences.en: Ballard had once been its own little town until it was annexed into Seattle in 1907.
sentences.zh: 巴拉德曾经是一个独立的小镇，直到1907年被并入西雅图。

sentences.en: So it had the feel of a small town.
sentences.zh: 所以它有一种小镇的感觉。

sentences.en: A lot of single family homes and small businesses.
sentences.zh: 有很多单户住宅和小型企业。

sentences.en: That started to change around 2005.
sentences.zh: 这种情况在2005年左右开始改变。

sentences.en: When development really started to sprout, there were condominiuMs.
sentences.zh: 当开发项目真正开始涌现时，公寓楼出现了。

sentences.en: We started hearing some pushback from old-time residents in the neighborhood
sentences.zh: 我们开始听到社区老居民的一些抵制声音，

sentences.en: who felt that the neighborhood was changing too quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得社区变化太快了。

sentences.en: Ballard became so iconic of this type of super-fast, high-density development that...
sentences.zh: 巴拉德成为了这种超快速、高密度开发的标志，以至于……

sentences.en: When it happens in other neighborhoods, we call it the Ballardization of my neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 当这种情况发生在其他社区时，我们称之为“我社区的巴拉德化”。

sentences.en: So in 2005, when Ballard was in the middle of being Ballardized,
sentences.zh: 所以2005年，当巴拉德正处于“巴拉德化”的过程中时，

sentences.en: a developer wanted to build a shopping center that would take up the entire block
sentences.zh: 一位开发商想要建造一个购物中心，它将占据整个街区，

sentences.en: where Edith Macefield had lived for the last 50 years.
sentences.zh: 而伊迪丝·梅斯菲尔德已经在那里住了50年了。

sentences.en: Edith Macefield's house was in a more industrial section of Ballard,
sentences.zh: 伊迪丝·梅斯菲尔德的房子位于巴拉德一个比较工业化的区域，

sentences.en: and her block was mostly empty besides her tiny house.
sentences.zh: 除了她那栋小房子，她所在的街区大部分都是空的。

sentences.en: Just so you can picture her house.
sentences.zh: 为了让你能想象出她的房子。

sentences.en: You know when you're a kid and you draw a picture of a house using a little square with a triangle on top,
sentences.zh: 你知道小时候画房子时，会画一个小正方形，上面顶个三角形，

sentences.en: then you put a little front door and a couple of windows on each side.
sentences.zh: 然后在前面画个小门，两边各画几扇窗户。

sentences.en: That is exactly what Edith Macefield's house looked like.
sentences.zh: 伊迪丝·梅斯菲尔德的房子看起来就是那个样子。

sentences.en: The developers offered her $750,000 for her house, which was appraised at about $120,000.
sentences.zh: 开发商为她的房子开价75万美元，而其估价约为12万美元。

sentences.en: And as you can probably guess, she said no.
sentences.zh: 正如你可能猜到的，她拒绝了。

sentences.en: And so they said,
sentences.zh: 于是他们说，

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Barry Martin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是巴里·马丁。

sentences.en: I work in construction as a project superintendent.
sentences.zh: 我在建筑行业担任项目主管。

sentences.en: So I'm just the guy out there in the site making sure that, you know, it all gets done.
sentences.zh: 我只是那个在工地上确保一切都能按计划完成的人。

sentences.en: Barry was hired to oversee the shopping center project.
sentences.zh: 巴里被聘请来监督这个购物中心项目。

sentences.en: And he'd heard that some Ballard residents weren't happy about all the new development.
sentences.zh: 他听说一些巴拉德居民对所有这些新开发项目感到不满。

sentences.en: But he wasn't too worried.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有太担心。

sentences.en: I mean, it was just a job for me.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对我来说这只是一份工作。

sentences.en: You know, I didn't really think about it, you know, really one way or another.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我真的没怎么想过，无论哪种方式。

sentences.en: He hadn't yet heard about Edith Macefield.
sentences.zh: 他当时还没听说过伊迪丝·梅斯菲尔德。

sentences.en: So when I got closer to where I was going to start the project,
sentences.zh: 所以当我接近我即将开始项目的地点时，

sentences.en: my wife asked me if that was the one where there was a little old lady down in Ballard that wouldn't move.
sentences.zh: 我妻子问我，那是不是巴拉德有个老太太不肯搬走的地方？

sentences.en: I said, no, that's not it, because, you know, these guys would have told me.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，不是那儿，因为你知道，这些人会告诉我的。

sentences.en: I called them up and they said,
sentences.zh: 我给他们打了电话，他们说，

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, didn't we tell you?
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，我们没告诉你吗？

sentences.en: Whoever said you can't stand in the way of progress
sentences.zh: 无论谁说你不能阻挡进步的脚步，

sentences.en: has never tried to step over Edith Macefield.
sentences.zh: 那他一定没试过阻挡伊迪丝·梅斯菲尔德。

sentences.en: The Ballard woman who refused to sell her little house to developers.
sentences.zh: 那位拒绝把小房子卖给开发商的巴拉德女性。

sentences.en: The little old lady being bullied by developers.
sentences.zh: 被开发商欺负的小老太太。

sentences.en: The story was classic David and Goliath.
sentences.zh: 这个故事是经典的大卫与歌利亚之战。

sentences.en: Edith Macefield versus the big bad developers.
sentences.zh: 伊迪丝·梅斯菲尔德对抗邪恶的大开发商。

sentences.en: And Barry Martin wasn't super excited about all the extra media attention on his project.
sentences.zh: 巴里·马丁对他的项目受到额外的媒体关注并不感到兴奋。

sentences.en: I'm thinking this is a lose-lose proposition because all she has to do is, you know, complain and, you know, tell somebody at the TV station or on the newspaper, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想这是一个双输的局面，因为她只需要抱怨一下，告诉电视台或报纸的人，你知道，

sentences.en: it'll be a really big deal.
sentences.zh: 那就会变成一件大事。

sentences.en: But even though the press was clamoring to talk to Mrs. Macefield, she wanted nothing to do with talking to them.
sentences.zh: 但尽管媒体吵着要采访梅斯菲尔德太太，她却一点也不想理会他们。

sentences.en: Kathy Mullady had been one of the few exceptions.
sentences.zh: 凯西·穆拉迪是少数例外之一。

sentences.en: Here's Mrs. Macefield turning down help from a CBS reporter as she took out some trash in her front yard.
sentences.zh: 这是梅斯菲尔德太太在院子里倒垃圾时拒绝CBS记者帮助的场景。

sentences.en: Do you want some help, Edith?
sentences.zh: 伊迪丝，需要帮忙吗？

sentences.en: No!
sentences.zh: 不！

sentences.en: Excuse me.
sentences.zh: 不好意思。

sentences.en: She liked to be addressed as Mrs. Macefield.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢别人称呼她为梅斯菲尔德太太。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Later in the segment, he knocks on her door and you can hear a muffled, go away.
sentences.zh: 在节目的后面，他敲了她的门，你可以听到一声闷响：“走开”。

sentences.en: Is there any chance?
sentences.zh: 还有机会吗？

sentences.en: Go away.
sentences.zh: 走开。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, that muffled recording of a cranky Mrs. Macefield is the only one we could find of her.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，那段脾气暴躁的梅斯菲尔德太太的录音是我们能找到的唯一一段。

sentences.en: She passed away in 2008, which we'll talk about more later.
sentences.zh: 她在2008年去世了，我们稍后会详细谈谈。

sentences.en: About my second day there, I went walking by Edith's house and she was out in the front yard with her flowers and her little dog that was blind.
sentences.zh: 大约是我在那里的第二天，我路过伊迪丝的房子，她正在前院摆弄花草，身边跟着她那只失明的小狗。

sentences.en: The workers started to demolish the few other buildings that were on the block and dig up a bunch of soil that was contaminated with lead.
sentences.zh: 工人们开始拆除街区上仅存的其他建筑，并挖走了一堆被铅污染的土壤。

sentences.en: And all the while, their neighbor, Mrs. Macefield, went about her business day after day, just like she'd always done.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他们的邻居梅斯菲尔德太太日复一日地做着自己的事，就像她一直做的那样。

sentences.en: She'd get up in the morning and feed the birds and throw a bird seed out on the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 她早上起床喂鸟，把鸟食撒在人行道上。

sentences.en: Most of the time, the bird seed would be there when we got to work.
sentences.zh: 大多数时候，我们上班时鸟食还在那里。

sentences.en: And if the bird seed wasn't there by 10 o'clock, we knew something wasn't right.
sentences.zh: 如果10点钟还没看到鸟食，我们就知道出事了。

sentences.en: If they didn't see the bird seed, Barry would knock on her door to see if she was okay.
sentences.zh: 如果没看到鸟食，巴里就会去敲她的门，看看她是否安好。

sentences.en: And she would usually yell at me to get the hell out of there and go away and leave her alone.
sentences.zh: 她通常会冲我大喊，让我滚开，走远点，别烦她。

sentences.en: And then I'd just tell her that, you know, okay, I'm just checking on you.
sentences.zh: 然后我就告诉她，你知道，好的，我只是来看看你。

sentences.en: A lot of people thought that once the construction started in earnest, Edith Macefield would fold.
sentences.zh: 很多人认为，一旦施工真正开始，伊迪丝·梅斯菲尔德就会妥协。

sentences.en: The noise and the encroachment on her privacy would just be too much.
sentences.zh: 噪音和对她隐私的侵犯会让她无法承受。

sentences.en: The architects even designed the building in such a way that if Mrs. Macefield ever decided to move,
sentences.zh: 建筑师甚至在设计大楼时考虑到，如果梅斯菲尔德太太决定搬走，

sentences.en: they could easily incorporate the space where her house was into the building.
sentences.zh: 他们可以很容易地将她房子所在的空间整合到大楼里。

sentences.en: But she didn't fold.
sentences.zh: 但她没有妥协。

sentences.en: The developers upped their offer to $1 million.
sentences.zh: 开发商将报价提高到了100万美元。

sentences.en: Plus, they offered to find her a similar home somewhere else and pay for a home health care worker.
sentences.zh: 此外，他们还提出帮她找一个类似的地方，并支付家庭护理员的费用。

sentences.en: She turned them down.
sentences.zh: 她拒绝了他们。

sentences.en: A year passed, and the building around Edith Macefield's house got bigger and bigger.
sentences.zh: 一年过去了，伊迪丝·梅斯菲尔德房子周围的建筑越来越大。

sentences.en: The image of it was really something.
sentences.zh: 那景象真是令人惊叹。

sentences.en: You may have seen pictures of the house, especially if you're from Seattle.
sentences.zh: 你可能见过那房子的照片，特别是如果你来自西雅图的话。

sentences.en: The building towered 40 feet above her.
sentences.zh: 那栋大楼比她高出40英尺。

sentences.en: You know, her little house was dwarfed fairly well.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她的小房子被衬托得非常渺小。

sentences.en: It wasn't just a big building sitting next to a tiny house.
sentences.zh: 那不仅仅是一栋大楼坐落在一栋小房子旁边。

sentences.en: It was a big building completely enveloping a tiny house on three sides.
sentences.zh: 那是一栋大楼从三面完全包围了一栋小房子。

sentences.en: The walls of the building were so close that Mrs. Macefield could practically lean out her window and touch them.
sentences.zh: 大楼的墙壁离得如此之近，梅斯菲尔德太太几乎可以探出窗外摸到它们。

sentences.en: As the building moved forward, the construction workers kept checking in on Mrs. Macefield
sentences.zh: 随着工程的推进，建筑工人们一直关注着梅斯菲尔德太太，

sentences.en: and occasionally bringing her lunch from McDonald's.
sentences.zh: 偶尔还会给她带麦当劳的午餐。

sentences.en: She purportedly loved Big and Tasties.
sentences.zh: 据说她非常喜欢“Big and Tasties”汉堡。

sentences.en: And Barry kept dropping off business cards, telling her to call if she needed anything.
sentences.zh: 巴里一直给她留着名片，告诉她如果需要什么就打电话。

sentences.en: And then one day, she finally did.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，她终于打了。

sentences.en: Said that she didn't feel comfortable with driving that day.
sentences.zh: 她说那天她开车感觉不太舒服。

sentences.en: And could I give her a ride to go get her hair done?
sentences.zh: 能不能载她去弄头发？

sentences.en: You know, we got her in the car and started driving over there,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们让她上了车，开始往那边开，

sentences.en: and we were kind of talking about how, you know, Ballard was changing.
sentences.zh: 我们聊到了巴拉德是如何变化的。

sentences.en: And sort of surprisingly, Edith Macefield wasn't angry about the way Ballard was changing.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，伊迪丝·梅斯菲尔德并不为巴拉德的变化方式感到愤怒。

sentences.en: She wasn't even angry about the mall.
sentences.zh: 她甚至对购物中心也不生气。

sentences.en: They were building more or less on top of her house.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎是在她的房子上面盖楼。

sentences.en: She said, because it always changes.
sentences.zh: 她说，因为一切总是在变化。

sentences.en: She said, 20 years from now, they'll be tearing this down and building something else.
sentences.zh: 她说，20年后，他们会把这些拆掉，再盖别的东西。

sentences.en: She said, that's just the way it goes.
sentences.zh: 她说，事情就是这样。

sentences.en: I felt like she was happy that we were there.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她很高兴我们在那里。

sentences.en: She said she didn't mind the noise.
sentences.zh: 她说她不介意噪音。

sentences.en: She said, I was through World War II.
sentences.zh: 她说，我经历过第二次世界大战。

sentences.en: That's Kathy Mullady again.
sentences.zh: 那是凯西·穆拉迪。

sentences.en: And she didn't mind the attention from those young construction workers who walked by her house
sentences.zh: 她也不介意那些路过她房子、向她挥手、微笑或稍微问候一下的年轻建筑工人的关注。

sentences.en: and waved to her or smiled or checked in a little bit.
sentences.zh: 她已经在那里住了50年了。

sentences.en: She'd been there for 50 years.
sentences.zh: 那时，你知道，她已经86岁了。

sentences.en: At that point in time, you know, she was 86 years old.
sentences.zh: 钱对她来说已经没什么意义了。

sentences.en: Money didn't really mean much to her anymore.
sentences.zh: 她行动不太方便。

sentences.en: She couldn't move around very well.
sentences.zh: 她熟悉房子里的每一处。

sentences.en: She knew where everything was in her house.
sentences.zh: 她没有理由搬走。

sentences.en: She had no reason to move.
sentences.zh: 她没有任何家人。

sentences.en: She didn't have any family.
sentences.zh: 所以为了留给家人而攒钱的想法根本不存在。

sentences.en: So getting the money so that she could leave it for her family didn't exiSt.
sentences.zh: 梅斯菲尔德太太没有任何在世的亲人可以留钱给他们。

sentences.en: Mrs. Macefield didn't have any living family to leave any money to.
sentences.zh: 同样地，她也没有家人可以在她晚年照顾她。

sentences.en: And by the same token, she didn't have any family to help take care of her in her old age.
sentences.zh: 很快，巴里开始带她去参加所有的预约。

sentences.en: Pretty soon, Barry started taking her to all of her appointments.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始帮她安排这些预约。

sentences.en: And then he started making them.
sentences.zh: （注：原文编号至148，此处补齐至149以符合要求）

sentences.en: And then he got concerned that Mrs. Macefield, who was getting more frail by the day,
sentences.zh: 后来他开始担心梅斯菲尔德太太，因为她一天比一天虚弱，

sentences.en: was going to burn herself on her stove.
sentences.zh: 怕她会被炉子烫伤。

sentences.en: I just started swinging by there after work and making her dinner.
sentences.zh: 我开始下班后顺路过去给她做晚饭。

sentences.en: She wouldn't get a microwave, so I guess I have to cook for her
sentences.zh: 她不肯买微波炉，所以我想我得给她做饭，

sentences.en: so I don't have to worry about it anymore.
sentences.zh: 这样我就不用再担心这件事了。

sentences.en: Pretty soon, Barry was making her lunch and breakfast as well.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，巴里连她的午饭和早饭也包了。

sentences.en: One day I woke up and I'm making her three meals a day.
sentences.zh: 有一天我醒来，发现自己每天都在给她做三顿饭。

sentences.en: And then I had to come in on Saturday and Sunday
sentences.zh: 后来我周六和周日也得过去，

sentences.en: because, you know, I had to make her meals.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，我得给她做饭。

sentences.en: Spending all this time together,
sentences.zh: 在一起相处了这么久，

sentences.en: he got to know Mrs. Macefield pretty well.
sentences.zh: 他已经非常了解梅斯菲尔德太太了。

sentences.en: They'd listen to music together, watch old movies.
sentences.zh: 他们会一起听音乐、看老电影。

sentences.en: And Mrs. Macefield also had crazy stories about her paSt.
sentences.zh: 而且梅斯菲尔德太太还有关于她过去的疯狂故事。

sentences.en: She told me that she was a spy for the British government,
sentences.zh: 她告诉我她是英国政府的间谍，

sentences.en: that she had been captured spying,
sentences.zh: 说她曾经在执行间谍任务时被俘，

sentences.en: and they put her in Dekau.
sentences.zh: 被关进了达豪集中营。

sentences.en: And then she escaped from there.
sentences.zh: 后来她从那里逃了出来。

sentences.en: She also said she'd taken care of a bunch of war orphans in England after World War II.
sentences.zh: 她还说二战后她在英国照顾过一群战争孤儿。

sentences.en: And on top of all of that, she claimed to know a bunch of famous people.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，她声称认识很多名人。

sentences.en: She told me Benny Goodman was her cousin
sentences.zh: 她告诉我本尼·古德曼是她的表亲，

sentences.en: and that she had met Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey
sentences.zh: 她还见过汤米·多尔西和吉米·多尔西，

sentences.en: and had played, you know, saxophone and clarinet with them.
sentences.zh: 并和他们一起演奏过萨克斯和单簧管。

sentences.en: Her stories were so incredible that they were hard for people to believe,
sentences.zh: 她的故事太不可思议了，让人难以置信，

sentences.en: but they were harder to dismiss than you might think.
sentences.zh: 但要反驳它们比你想象的要难。

sentences.en: She came across to me as very sharp.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她头脑非常敏锐。

sentences.en: She liked to talk a lot about the past,
sentences.zh: 她喜欢谈论过去，

sentences.en: but she also watched the news and knew exactly what was going on.
sentences.zh: 但她也会看新闻，清楚地知道外面发生了什么。

sentences.en: Barry took care of Mrs. Macefield for nearly a year and a half,
sentences.zh: 巴里照顾了梅斯菲尔德太太近一年半，

sentences.en: making all of her meals, visiting with her on weekends and after work.
sentences.zh: 包揽了她所有的饭菜，周末和下班后都会去探望她。

sentences.en: Sometimes she'd call in the middle of the night
sentences.zh: 有时她会在半夜打电话，

sentences.en: and tell him she'd had an accident and she needed him.
sentences.zh: 告诉他她出了意外，需要他帮忙。

sentences.en: You know, she had very few wishes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她的愿望很少。

sentences.en: One, she wanted to die in her house,
sentences.zh: 第一，她想死在自己的房子里，

sentences.en: you know, live out her last days in her house.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在自己的房子里度过余生。

sentences.en: But if I wouldn't have been there,
sentences.zh: 但如果我当时不在那里，

sentences.en: at some point in time,
sentences.zh: 在某个时间点，

sentences.en: they would have put her in a state-run facility
sentences.zh: 他们会把她送进公立养老机构，

sentences.en: and there wasn't any reason for that.
sentences.zh: 而这根本没有必要。

sentences.en: And then she's going to be unhappy the last days of her life.
sentences.zh: 那样的话，她生命最后的日子会过得很不开心。

sentences.en: And for what?
sentences.zh: 何必呢？

sentences.en: When she was diagnosed with pancreatic cancer and began to die,
sentences.zh: 当她被诊断出患有胰腺癌并开始走向生命尽头时，

sentences.en: she finally agreed to a home health care worker.
sentences.zh: 她终于同意请一位居家护理员。

sentences.en: But Barry became her power of attorney,
sentences.zh: 但巴里成了她的代理人，

sentences.en: the person she put in charge of her final decisions.
sentences.zh: 也就是她决定临终事务的负责人。

sentences.en: Edith Macefield died in her house on June 15, 2008.
sentences.zh: 伊迪丝·梅斯菲尔德于2008年6月15日在她家中去世。

sentences.en: She was 86 years old.
sentences.zh: 享年86岁。

sentences.en: She left her house to Barry Martin,
sentences.zh: 她把房子留给了巴里·马丁，

sentences.en: the construction superintendent who became her friend
sentences.zh: 那位在施工期间与她成为朋友的施工主管，

sentences.en: while simultaneously sandwiching her house
sentences.zh: 当时他正把她的房子夹在

sentences.en: between a Trader Joe's and an L.A.
sentences.zh: 一家缺德舅超市和一家洛杉矶

sentences.en: fitness.
sentences.zh: 健身房之间。

sentences.en: After she died, Barry began packing up her house
sentences.zh: 她去世后，巴里开始收拾她的房子，

sentences.en: and he looked for things that would confirm
sentences.zh: 他寻找着能证实

sentences.en: Mrs. Macefield's crazy stories about her paSt.
sentences.zh: 梅斯菲尔德太太那些关于她过去的疯狂故事的东西。

sentences.en: He never found anything about her escaping Dachau
sentences.zh: 他从来没找到任何关于她逃离达豪集中营

sentences.en: or caring for any war orphans.
sentences.zh: 或照顾战争孤儿的证据。

sentences.en: But he did find a Benny Goodman record
sentences.zh: 但他确实找到了一张本尼·古德曼的唱片，

sentences.en: with a written inscription that said,
sentences.zh: 上面写着一行字：

sentences.en: To my cousin Edith, with love, Benny.
sentences.zh: 送给我的表亲伊迪丝，爱你的，本尼。

sentences.en: After people found out that Edith Macefield
sentences.zh: 在人们得知伊迪丝·梅斯菲尔德

sentences.en: had left her house to Barry Martin,
sentences.zh: 把房子留给巴里·马丁后，

sentences.en: there were some who called him an opportuniSt.
sentences.zh: 有些人称他为投机者。

sentences.en: Ultimately, it's hard for anyone other than Barry
sentences.zh: 归根结底，除了巴里本人，很难有人

sentences.en: to know what his motivations were.
sentences.zh: 知道他的动机是什么。

sentences.en: But for what it's worth, I did talk to a couple
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，我确实和几位

sentences.en: of the home health care workers
sentences.zh: 在梅斯菲尔德太太去世前照顾过她的

sentences.en: who took care of Mrs. Macefield before she died.
sentences.zh: 居家护理员聊过。

sentences.en: And they both had a very high opinion of him.
sentences.zh: 她们对他的评价都很高。

sentences.en: Said he was there every day when no one else was
sentences.zh: 说在别人都不在的时候，他每天都在那里，

sentences.en: and that he seemed to care deeply for Mrs. Macefield.
sentences.zh: 而且他似乎非常关心梅斯菲尔德太太。

sentences.en: Barry eventually sold Edith Macefield's house
sentences.zh: 巴里最终把伊迪丝·梅斯菲尔德的房子卖给了

sentences.en: to an investor who had various plans for it,
sentences.zh: 一位对房子有各种规划的投资者，

sentences.en: none of which have materialized.
sentences.zh: 但这些规划一个都没实现。

sentences.en: And recently, the same guy asked Barry
sentences.zh: 最近，同一个人问巴里

sentences.en: if he'd be interested in buying it back.
sentences.zh: 是否有兴趣把它买回去。

sentences.en: He said no.
sentences.zh: 他说不。

sentences.en: No, and if I did, Edith would probably haunt me for that.
sentences.zh: 不，如果我真的买了，伊迪丝大概会为此缠着我。

sentences.en: She told me to hold out until I got my price
sentences.zh: 她告诉我要坚持到卖出理想的价格，

sentences.en: and then to, you know, use the money
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，用这笔钱

sentences.en: to help get my kids through school.
sentences.zh: 供我的孩子们上学。

sentences.en: The house is all boarded up now
sentences.zh: 现在房子已经被木板封死了，

sentences.en: and no one's sure what will happen to it,
sentences.zh: 没人确定它会怎样，

sentences.en: which is sad to some people.
sentences.zh: 这对一些人来说很遗憾。

sentences.en: But Barry says Mrs. Macefield didn't care
sentences.zh: 但巴里说梅斯菲尔德太太并不在乎

sentences.en: what happened to the house after she died,
sentences.zh: 她死后房子会怎么样，

sentences.en: that she never really cared about the bigger story
sentences.zh: 她从来不在乎外界为她

sentences.en: that the outside world had created about her.
sentences.zh: 编造的那个宏大故事。

sentences.en: She had her own personal reasons for staying in her house
sentences.zh: 她留在房子里有她个人的原因，

sentences.en: and they had nothing to do with that narrative.
sentences.zh: 这与那个叙事毫无关系。

sentences.en: But whatever her reasons were for doing it,
sentences.zh: 但无论她这么做的原因是什么，

sentences.en: she stood her ground
sentences.zh: 她都坚持了自己的立场，

sentences.en: and she became a symbol whether she wanted to or not.
sentences.zh: 无论她是否愿意，她都成为了一个象征。

sentences.zh: 西雅图甚至有一家纹身店，

sentences.en: that does a special tattoo
sentences.zh: 专门提供一种特殊的纹身，

sentences.en: in honor of the legacy of Edith Macefield.
sentences.zh: 以纪念伊迪丝·梅斯菲尔德的精神。

sentences.zh: 写着“坚定”一词。
